text: SCOPE ADDITION (round-31b, user): the plan-view companion bubble currently renders the agent AVATAR (initials) — replace with a proper chat-FAB look: a message/chat-bubble ICON as the button face (lucide MessageCircle family, consistent with our icon set), with the agent's presence kept as a small status ring/dot on the bubble edge and the agent's name in the tooltip only. Same size/position/behavior otherwise (popover unchanged). Mobile relevance: on phone the bubble must not overlap the compact header's expand affordance or the composer — verify placement at 390x844 in this lane's scenarios (add assertion: bubble does not intersect the header bar or input). Criterion addition: companion bubble face is the chat icon, presence as ring; avatar/initials no longer the face.

Scope addition from Andrey: plan-view companion bubble should read as a chat bubble, not avatar; use MessageCircle-style icon face, edge presence ring/dot, name in tooltip, unchanged popover behavior, and 390x844 placement assertion avoiding compact header/composer overlap.

SCOPE ADDITION (round-32c, user): mobile tap targets — sidebar rows/tabs are too narrow on phone, hard to hit. On coarse-pointer/narrow viewports every interactive row (tabs, plan entry, section headers, expand chevrons, badges acting as buttons) gets >=44px hit height (Apple HIG minimum) — visual density may stay via inner padding, but the HIT AREA must be 44px. Add to the Playwright scenarios: bounding-box height assertion >=44 for tab rows and the compact-header bar at 390x844.

SCOPE ADDITION (round-34, user + screenshot /Users/rollacode/.codeterm/uploads/0a01f5e1-CodeTerm.heic): CHAT MESSAGES GO FULL-WIDTH ON MOBILE. On narrow viewports the message bubbles keep the desktop max-width proportion (~65-70%), wasting a third of an already-small screen and making messages read 'shortened'. Rule: below the md breakpoint, bubbles span the full content width (edge padding only, ~12px); alignment stays (user right / agent left) via padding asymmetry or a slim alignment accent, not via width reduction. Applies to user and agent bubbles, cards (reminder/intro), and code blocks inside messages (code blocks already suffer worst from the narrow column). Playwright addition at 390x844: bubble content width >= 90% of the chat container width for a long message. SECONDARY finding in the same shot: a codeterm:reminder marker rendered as RAW TEXT inside a message bubble instead of the structured Reminder card — markers embedded in message bodies must render structured wherever the top-level path already does; add a component test with a marker mid-body.

SCOPE ADDITION (round-34b, user + screenshot 7725abd5): TERMINAL TAB BLANK ON MOBILE WEB — the Terminal face renders an empty area on iOS Safari web-mode (toolbar + esc/arrows/enter helpers render, terminal canvas empty). VERIFY-FIRST: the user notes this may already be fixed — the PTY reader-race fix cured a blank-terminal class; reproduce on CURRENT dev from a phone (or Safari responsive mode) before coding. If still broken, likely suspects in order: (1) xterm renderer on iOS Safari (WebGL renderer unsupported/context-lost -> needs canvas/dom renderer fallback), (2) fit-addon sizing against a zero-height flex container on mobile layout, (3) the mobile keyboard-helpers bar changing the container height after xterm measured. Acceptance: on 390x844 web-mode, the Terminal tab of a live agent pane shows real PTY content within 2s of switching; add to this lane's Playwright scenarios (webkit project if available, else chromium mobile emulation) with a content assertion (non-empty rows in the xterm buffer).

Accepted and merged earlier; confirmed by Dali. Mobile compact header, companion chat bubble, coarse-pointer hit targets, and desktop-preservation gates are in current head 5e679362. Worker and eight worktree/branch/dev were cleaned after merge.
